subject: Aurora AI — Sales→CS Transfer and Go‑Live Prep

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marta Diaz <marta@aurora.ai>, Alex Chen <alex.chen@aurora.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 24 Jul 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Aurora AI — Handoff: SOW, key commitments, and next steps

Team / Marta / Alex,

Thanks again for a strong finish to contracting — Aurora's VP of Product (Marta) signed the SOW yesterday. Quick summary to transfer custody to CS and start implementation planning:

- Contract: Annual, 500k committed spend, start date target 2028-08-15. SOW attached (Aurora_SOW_v3.pdf).
- Primary contact: Marta Diaz (VP Product) — marta@aurora.ai; secondary contact (technical): Alex Chen — alex.chen@aurora.ai.
- Initial scope: host Redwood-managed inference (Hosted API) for two customer-facing use cases (support summarization and recommendation rerank).
- Acceptance criteria (high level): 95th pctl token latency < 250ms for support flow; baseline top-3 rerank accuracy on internal benchmark within 3% of GA model. Detailed acceptance in attachment (aurora-acceptance-checklist.xlsx).
- Sensitive requirements: Data residency in us-west only; SOC2 evidence required for architecture review; no third-party analytics.
- Technical notes from discovery: average request size ~650 tokens, bursty traffic around PST business hours, plan to stage with dedicated pool after initial pilot.

Asks for CS:
1) Own kickoff scheduling and runbook for 2-week pilot (target start 2028-08-15).
2) Confirm pre-golive tech gaps (network IP allowlist, VPC peering options, KMS integration for keys).
3) Assign primary CS owner and shadow for escalation path.

Recommended CS owner: Tessa Morgan (she's done two recent Hosted→Dedicated migrations). Vivek — please advise on capacity/burst reservation ops. Karthik — I can pass along any other commercial context you want included.

Marta/Alex — please confirm your availability for a 60-min kickoff the week of Aug 7th and any calendar constraints.

Thanks,
Neha
Account Exec | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0194

Attachment: Aurora_SOW_v3.pdf
Attachment: aurora-acceptance-checklist.xlsx

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 25 Jul 2028 11:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aurora AI — Handoff: SOW, key commitments, and next steps

Thanks Neha — good summary. Welcome Aurora team.

Tessa — can you take primary ownership for implementation? If yes, please:
- Confirm kickoff cadence and owners for engineering/infra/ops.
- Validate acceptance criteria in the checklist and call out any items that need clarification from the customer.
- Identify any gating security evidence (SOC2 artifacts, pen test reports) we need to collect pre-kickoff.

Notes from my side: sales committed to a single dedicated pilot cluster after pilot if performance meets SLA; budget includes a one‑time migration credit we can use for quantization/optimization work. Also, procurement asked to reserve a 30-day SLA exception window (we can discuss with Security).

Tessa — if you accept, please reply with: primary owner, shadow, proposed 60-min kickoff windows (Aug 7–9), and a short list of pre-kickoff items (IP whitelist, sample request payloads, expected peak RPS).

Karthik
Head of Customer Success Operations | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

Hi all,

Happy to own this. Short plan and owners below:

- Primary CS Owner: Tessa Morgan (tessa.morgan@redwood.ai) — overall implementation lead and success POC.
- Shadow/Technical Lead: Vivek Kulkarni (vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai) — responsible for capacity planning, Dedicated pool sizing, and ops runbook.
- Delivery Engineer: assigned once kickoff artifacts reviewed (I will nominate E a week before kickoff).

Kickoff windows (60 min):
- Tue Aug 8, 2028 10:00–11:00 PT (preferred; Marta/Alex tentative)
- Wed Aug 9, 2028 09:00–10:00 PT (backup)

Pre-kickoff checklist items (I'll own these with the client):
- IP whitelist and allowlist details (client to provide)
- SOC2 report and architecture diagram (Neha to send to my inbox and to Security if needed)
- Sample request/response payloads and sanitized dataset (Aurora to upload by Aug 3rd)
- Confirm KMS key rotation requirements and whether HSM is required
- Define staging acceptance runs and metric collection window (we'll run 48h load test to validate latency SLA)

Marta/Alex — please confirm the Aug 8 slot if that remains good, and send the sanitized dataset and any SAML/SAML metadata if you plan SSO during pilot.

I'll create a kickoff agenda and send calendar invite and meeting notes link once the time is confirmed.

Thanks,
